bio.text: Carol Dalby, a Republican, represents Arkansas House District 100, which includes Texarkana and a portion of Miller County, and is serving her 5th term; she chairs the House Judiciary Committee for the 95th General Assembly.

She is an attorney practicing in Texarkana; she graduated from Ouachita Baptist University, earned a master's degree from East Texas State University and a Juris Doctor from the University of Arkansas School of Law.
Dalby previously served as president of the Texarkana School Board and was appointed to serve as District Judge in Miller County and as a Special Justice to the Arkansas Supreme Court.
